title: Monotonicity of local conditional steps
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, let $V$ be a variable set, and let a constraint satisfaction instance on $V$ have a nonempty multiset of constraints in which every variable occurs. Starting from any state consisting of a family of probability laws on $D$, a label assignment, and a natural-number work total, applying the local conditional step successively to the variables in any finite list produces a state whose local expected value is at least that of the initial state.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable occurs in some constraint scope
